list.name: router
list.label: Advertising router
list.query: SELECT IPv6NumToString(router_ip) AS __value, router_sysname AS __text FROM (SELECT router_sysname, router_ip FROM vantage.ls_nodes_current UNION DISTINCT SELECT router_sysname, router_ip FROM vantage.ls_links_current UNION DISTINCT SELECT router_sysname, router_ip FROM vantage.ls_nodes UNION DISTINCT SELECT router_sysname, router_ip FROM vantage.ls_links) GROUP BY router_sysname, router_ip ORDER BY router_sysname

list.name: peer
list.label: BMP peer
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT IPv6NumToString(peer_ip) FROM (SELECT peer_ip, router_ip FROM vantage.ls_nodes_current UNION DISTINCT SELECT peer_ip, router_ip FROM vantage.ls_links_current UNION DISTINCT SELECT peer_ip, router_ip FROM vantage.ls_nodes UNION DISTINCT SELECT peer_ip, router_ip FROM vantage.ls_links) WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router') ORDER BY 1

list.name: focus
list.label: Focus node
list.query:
WITH current_session AS (
    SELECT collector_id, max(session_id) AS sid
    FROM vantage.peer_current
    WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router')
    GROUP BY collector_id
),
nodeset AS (
    SELECT k,
           argMin(name, collector_id) AS name,
           argMin(router_id, collector_id) AS router_id,
           argMin(router_id_v4, collector_id) AS router_id_v4
    FROM (
        SELECT collector_id, node_key AS k,
               argMax(name, (seq, stream_seq)) AS name,
               router_id,
               argMax(router_id_v4, (seq, stream_seq)) AS router_id_v4,
               argMax(is_withdraw, (seq, stream_seq)) AS wd
        FROM vantage.ls_nodes_current
        WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router')
          AND peer_ip = toIPv6('$peer')
          AND (collector_id, session_id) IN (SELECT collector_id, sid FROM current_session)
        GROUP BY collector_id, protocol, identifier, asn, bgpls_id, area, router_id, node_key
    )
    WHERE wd IN ($state)
    GROUP BY k
)
SELECT toString(k) AS __value,
       multiIf(name != '', name,
               router_id_v4 != '', router_id_v4,
               length(router_id) = 8, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(reverse(unhex(router_id)))),
               router_id) AS __text
FROM nodeset
ORDER BY __text

list.name: collector
list.label: Collector
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT collector_id FROM vantage.peer_current WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router') ORDER BY collector_id

panels.title: Carried by the current session — $collector
panels.description:
Adjacencies this router's CURRENT BMP session carries, against adjacencies seen anywhere in the dashboard's time range.

The table below shows only the current session, so when these two numbers differ it is showing you less than the archive holds -- and when the first reads 0 against a non-zero second, the table is blank because this router has not re-dumped since it reconnected, NOT because it has no topology. Three of the four routers carrying link-state in this archive are in exactly that state: one holds 86 nodes and shows none.

It ignores $state and $focus deliberately. Those controls narrow what the table draws; this is the denominator they are narrowing, so focusing one node must not change it. link-state-topology's "View completeness by router" gives the same comparison for every router at once.

The first number reads the current-state tables (peer_current and the ls_*_current table), which have no retention TTL, so a session that has been up and unchanged for longer than history retention still counts everything it carries. The second is history bounded by the time range, by design.

targets.rawSql:
WITH current_session AS (
    SELECT collector_id, max(session_id) AS sid
    FROM vantage.peer_current WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router')
    GROUP BY collector_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT countDistinct((local_node_key, remote_node_key)) FROM vantage.ls_links_current
     WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router') AND peer_ip = toIPv6('$peer')
       AND collector_id = '$collector'
       AND (collector_id, session_id) IN (SELECT collector_id, sid FROM current_session)) AS in_current_session,
    (SELECT countDistinct((local_node_key, remote_node_key)) FROM vantage.ls_links
     WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router') AND peer_ip = toIPv6('$peer')
       AND collector_id = '$collector'
       AND $__timeFilter(ts_collector)) AS in_window

panels.title: Links
panels.description:
Adjacencies of the selected router's current BMP session. Both endpoints are decoded from hex here because ls_links carries no v4 columns, so an endpoint that was never advertised as a node has no other source for its address. The interface addresses and link IDs are not decoration: they are part of a link's identity, and the only thing that tells two parallel links between the same pair of routers apart.

`admin_group` is empty on every row this archive holds -- all 229 of them. That is a real state, not a decoding failure: this deployment's routers are configured with no link admin groups (RFC 5305 colors), so there is nothing to advertise. It is noted here because a column of zeroes otherwise reads as a parser that stopped working.

It ignores $collector deliberately: a dual-homed router's session is one per collector, so the table lists every collector's current-session links at once, in a leading collector column, rather than narrowing to the one the picker names.

targets.rawSql:
WITH current_session AS (
    SELECT collector_id, max(session_id) AS sid
    FROM vantage.peer_current
    WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router')
    GROUP BY collector_id
)
SELECT
    collector_id AS collector,
    if(length(local_router_id) = 8,
       IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(reverse(unhex(local_router_id)))),
       local_router_id) AS local,
    local_ifaddr,
    link_local_id,
    if(length(remote_router_id) = 8,
       IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(reverse(unhex(remote_router_id)))),
       remote_router_id) AS remote,
    remote_ifaddr,
    link_remote_id,
    argMax(igp_metric, (seq, stream_seq)) AS igp_metric,
    argMax(te_metric, (seq, stream_seq)) AS te_metric,
    argMax(admin_group, (seq, stream_seq)) AS admin_group,
    argMax(max_bandwidth, (seq, stream_seq)) AS max_bandwidth,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> toString(x), argMax(adj_sids, (seq, stream_seq))), ', ') AS adj_sids,
    max(ts_collector) AS last_seen
FROM vantage.ls_links_current
WHERE router_ip = toIPv6('$router')
  AND peer_ip = toIPv6('$peer')
  AND (collector_id, session_id) IN (SELECT collector_id, sid FROM current_session)
  AND (toUInt64('$focus') = 0
       OR local_node_key = toUInt64('$focus')
       OR remote_node_key = toUInt64('$focus'))
GROUP BY collector, protocol, identifier,
         local_asn, local_bgpls_id, local_area, local_router_id,
         remote_asn, remote_bgpls_id, remote_area, remote_router_id,
         local_ifaddr, remote_ifaddr, link_local_id, link_remote_id
HAVING argMax(is_withdraw, (seq, stream_seq)) IN ($state)
ORDER BY collector, local, remote, local_ifaddr, remote_ifaddr
